local_capabilities.evidence: Aurex has checksum-verified canonical Binance Vision spot OHLCV, continuity audits, immutable bundles, and deterministic transforms.
Current execution and broker schemas have no derivatives collateral, maintenance margin, leverage bracket, or margin-balance state.
local_capabilities.blocking_reason: A carry replay cannot measure insolvency or capital usage without point-in-time collateral and margin semantics.

local_capabilities.evidence: Aurex stores generic modeled commission and slippage but no dated USD-M futures maker/taker or account-tier fee schedule.
local_capabilities.blocking_reason: Current generic costs cannot establish fee-net derivatives carry.

local_capabilities.evidence: No Aurex ledger applies signed funding cashflows at exchange funding timestamps to a perpetual position.
local_capabilities.blocking_reason: Funding carry cannot be tested without exact payer/receiver and settlement-notional arithmetic.

local_capabilities.evidence: No local evidence bundle contains point-in-time USD-M perpetual funding rates or settlement timestamps.
local_capabilities.blocking_reason: The defining carry cashflow is absent from Aurex evidence.

local_capabilities.evidence: Current paper execution closes spot-style trades but has no mark-price liquidation, maintenance margin, insurance, or ADL behavior.
local_capabilities.blocking_reason: A hedge can fail before convergence if its perpetual leg liquidates or is auto-deleveraged.

local_capabilities.evidence: Current order intent and paper trade models represent one symbol leg and do not atomically coordinate spot-long and perpetual-short legs.
local_capabilities.blocking_reason: Legging, partial-fill, cancel, rollback, and residual-delta risk are not represented.

local_capabilities.evidence: No local artifact records historical USD-M contract status, quantity filters, price filters, leverage brackets, or funding interval changes.
local_capabilities.blocking_reason: Present-day contract metadata cannot be projected backward safely.

local_capabilities.evidence: No local bundle contains perpetual mark-price, index-price, or premium index history aligned with spot data.
local_capabilities.blocking_reason: Liquidation, fair basis, and funding context cannot be reconstructed.

local_capabilities.evidence: Aurex has spot candles only and no synchronized perpetual execution price or point-in-time spot-perpetual basis series.
local_capabilities.blocking_reason: Entry, exit, convergence, and dislocation P/L are not measurable.

local_capabilities.evidence: The live adapter registry returns only disabled or unregistered adapters and supports no live order submission.
local_capabilities.blocking_reason: No qualified spot or derivatives production execution path exists.

local_capabilities.evidence: Generic broker reconciliation exists, but no paired-leg position, funding, margin, or liquidation reconciliation contract exists.
local_capabilities.blocking_reason: Aurex cannot prove hedge quantity, cashflow, collateral, and venue state agree after each lifecycle event.
